Alger, 30 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L'o: Algiers, August 30, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Mobile operator Djezzy announces a solidarity initiative for residents of the wilayas hit by wildfires, by granting free volumes of calls, SMS, and data. This measure is part of the directives from the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications.
Une réponse immédiate aux besoins des si: An immediate response to the needs of disaster victims
L'opérateur Djezzy a lancé une opération: Operator Djezzy has launched an exceptional operation to support populations affected by the recent fires in Algeria. In a press release published Saturday, the company specifies that its customers residing in the affected areas will receive free volumes of calls, SMS, and internet. A confirmation SMS will be sent to beneficiaries to activate these benefits.
Cette initiative s'aligne sur les orient: This initiative aligns with the guidelines of the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, aimed at strengthening the solidarity efforts deployed by the government in the face of this exceptional situation. Djezzy reaffirms its commitment to mobilizing its resources to ensure the continuity of communications and support the national momentum of resilience.
Les incendies ont touché plusieurs wilay: The fires have affected several wilayas, particularly in the East and Center of the country, requiring a coordinated response from institutions. Families of victims evacuated to the Zéralda burn victim hospital have praised the total mobilization of the State and popular solidarity. The Minister of Hydraulics, Lounès Bouzegza, also instructed the acceleration of the census of damaged infrastructure and the rehabilitation of drinking water networks in the disaster areas.
Les opérations de lutte contre les incen: Firefighting operations continue with the mobilization of human, material, and aerial resources, under the coordination of the Ministry of Interior, Local Authorities, and Transport. Fourteen people evacuated from Jijel to Oran for specialized care were admitted to the hospital facility dedicated to severe burn victims.
